base_basis: ASSUMED: spine, SU, VM, 4 HBM PHYs, UCIe and gated tiles
every_op_field_wide: each ME op's rounds cover all 6,144 groups (the K split times the tiles a round), so every op start steps the whole field; 217 starts a token (72 KV-sourced)

schedule.basis: tools/hdc_timing.simulate replay of the TP-4 die program, SW = 64, W12 wires (+81 an op)

product_choice.what: a 75% concurrent-tile cap and a 256-cycle schedule-driven pre-ramp before every ME op
product_choice.why: meets 35 mV at 2 pH / 15 uF (the V4.1 package spec) at the smallest per-user cost
reference_rows: gap_preramp256 (no cap: 35 mV only to 1 pH)

verdict: full-field step 1826 A (1278 W) vs the V4.1 die's 2,625 A: ramp17 227.9 mV at 2 pH / 15 uF; preramp256 44.6 mV (0 cycles); cap50+preramp256 22.6 mV but +13.8% cycles (the cap doubles every op's issue)
claim_boundary: lumped L-C-R first droop (W18's model and assumptions: R_pkg, detector, DTC, L and C sweeps); tile power from a pre-route CTS database synthesised at TT with ripple adders, not a signed-off tile; base current assumed
